title: Dark Tree Crystal Mine
subtitle: Crystal Minds and Shattered Souls, Mining Storage Chest in the south-east corner
steps: Talk to the Student in Glenden Wood (29.9N 27.1E).
Go to the Dark Tree Crystal Mine (24.8N 31.3W, near Danby's Outpost on the Town Network).
In the south-east corner, take a Dark Tree Crystal from a Mining Storage Chest.
Take it to Arwic, then on to Lartorus (42.6N 62.4E).

notes.title: Which chest
notes.body: All six Mining Storage Chests hold a Dark Tree Crystal, so any of them works. The route goes to the south-east pair, as the quest guide says. Each one refills 30 seconds after it is emptied.

notes.title: Skip the holes
notes.body: Some drops here land on a Surface portal that sends you out. Follow the route rather than jumping down.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Hardened Obsidian Golems take full bludgeon and 0.9 pierce, but only 0.1 cold. Frost Golems take most from fire (0.7). Molten Golems take full cold and are immune to fire. Iron Golems take full acid and electric.

notes.title: Entry
notes.body: You need to be level 40 to use the entrance portal. The golems here are level 160 to 200.
